My team is monitoring this situation closely and is in contact with city agencies to see how we can be of assistance.

Grateful to @FDNY and all first responders on the scene. Residents of this 32-unit building on Washington Ave have been relocated to a reception center at P.S. 159 (2315 Washington Ave), where @RedCross is on site to assist.

Street closures are in effect on 184th St, Bathgate Ave, and Bassford Ave. Please avoid the area.


FDNY (@FDNY)

In commemoration of the tragic Happy Land Social Club fire in the Bronx, I introduced a resolution to designate March 25 as a day of remembrance. May we honor the 87 lives lost and recommit to advocating for safety, dignity, and justice for all communities.

The crisis of extremist settler violence in the West Bank must be confronted, and the perpetrators must be prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.

There should be zero tolerance for violent extremism, no matter what form it takes and no matter what direction from which it comes.
Eid Mubarak to all who celebrate. Wishing you a joyful day filled with peace, gratitude, and time with loved ones.

Thrilled to hear of Dylan Lopez Contreras's release. Dylan spent 10 months in federal detention for the crime of going to school, working as a delivery driver, and supporting his family.

The Trump administration viewed him as a threat. In The Bronx, we call him what he is: the embodiment of the American dream.

This is bigotry from a sitting U.S. Senator, plain and simple. Take it down.


Coach Tommy Tuberville (@SenTuberville)

The enemy is inside the gates.

Colette Smith never smoked. But she got lung cancer anyway. A CT scan caught it early and saved her life. Now she's fighting so others get that same chance.

That's why I introduced the Lung Cancer Screening Expansion Act: free annual scans, no insurance barriers, no red tape.

Anyone can get lung cancer, and everyone deserves a shot at catching it early.

It was an honor to welcome Speaker Emerita @SpeakerPelosi to the Bronx for Women’s History Month. As the first woman to serve as Speaker of the House, she shattered ceilings and delivered historic progress for the American people.

The President, as Commander in Chief, has the power to command the military in a war that Congress has authorized. With respect to the war in Iran, authorization has neither been sought by the President nor granted by Congress.
